chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The father is not killed for his son if he kills him, while the son is killed for his father if he kills his father.

key_terms.بِأَبِيهِ: for his father; in retaliation for killing his father
key_terms.بِابْنِهِ: for his son; in retaliation for killing his son
key_terms.يُقْتَلُ: is put to death in legal retaliation

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a father kills his son or a son kills his father in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning retaliation in cases of homicide between a father and his son. It distinguishes between the ruling for a father who kills his son and the ruling for a son who kills his father, reflecting a specific judgment in Islamic jurisprudence.
